records.source_title: Kerr LA, Johnson BJ, Burrows GE. Intoxication of cattle by Perilla frutescens (purple mint). Veterinary and Human Toxicology. 1986;28(5):412-416.
records.plant_part_state: feeding-trial plant material; flowering/seed stage discussed
records.supports: 소에게 실제 들깨(Perilla frutescens) 식물체를 먹인 수의독성 연구다. 5마리 중 3마리에서 비정형 간질성 폐렴이 발생했고, 부검에서는 폐기종과 폐부종이 확인됐다. 증상을 일으킨 양은 녹색 종실기 식물체 2.3–15.5 kg 또는 건초 11.8 kg 범위였다. HPLC 분석에서는 개화·종실기 부위의 perilla ketone 농도가 가장 높았고, 실제 급여시험에서도 이 생육단계가 가장 독성이 강했다. 따라서 들깨에는 실제 동물에서 확인된 생육단계 의존적 독성 위험이 있다는 강한 수의학적 경고 근거로 사용한다.
records.does_not_support: 이 연구의 대상은 소이며 육지거북이 아니다. 소에서 증상을 일으킨 kg 단위 용량을 육지거북의 독성량·안전량으로 환산할 수 없고, 한국에서 식용으로 재배되는 모든 들깨 품종과 모든 잎이 같은 perilla ketone 농도를 가진다는 뜻도 아니다. 따라서 ‘한 입만 먹어도 중독된다’는 결론이나 육지거북의 정확한 위험 용량을 이 연구만으로 정할 수 없다.

records.source_title: Determination of toxic perilla ketone, secondary plant metabolites and antioxidative capacity in five Perilla frutescens L. varieties. Food and Chemical Toxicology. 2010;48(1):264-270.
records.supports: P. frutescens 5개 유전자형을 비교해 perilla ketone(PK), 페놀류, 카로티노이드 등을 분석한 연구다. GC/MS에서 5개 중 2개 유전자형에서 독성 성분인 PK가 검출됐고, 연구진은 이 두 유전자형을 섭취에 부적합한 것으로 평가했다. 반대로 PK가 검출되지 않은 유전자형도 있어 들깨의 화학형·유전자형에 따라 위험 성분 수준이 크게 달라질 수 있음을 보여준다.
records.does_not_support: 5개 유전자형의 성분 비교 연구이지 육지거북 급여시험이 아니다. 따라서 특정 국내 식용 품종이 PK-free인지 확인하지 않은 상태에서 안전하다고 단정할 수 없고, 반대로 모든 들깨가 동일한 농도의 PK를 가진다고 일반화할 수도 없다. 육지거북의 독성 역치·안전 급여량·빈도도 제시하지 않는다.

records.supports: 알제리 야생 그리스육지거북 44개체(성체 수컷 20, 성체 암컷 16, 유체 8)의 분변에서 총 4,422개 먹이 조각을 분류한 연구다. Cynodon dactylon의 잎은 수컷·암컷·유체에서 각각 약 11.9%·9.0%·10.0%, 줄기는 약 2.5%·2.1%·2.7%의 분변 조각으로 확인됐다. 연구 전체에서 식물의 영양생장 조직이 생식 조직보다 많이 검출됐고, C. dactylon은 현장에서도 풍부하면서 실제 식단의 주요 벼과 먹이 중 하나였다.
records.does_not_support: 분변 조각의 상대빈도는 사육 급여 비율이나 영양 기여율과 동일하지 않으며 부드러운 조직은 소화되어 덜 검출될 수 있다. 알제리의 한 야생 개체군 연구이므로 모든 그리스육지거북 개체군에서 같은 비율로 먹는다는 뜻이 아니고, 버뮤다그래스를 단독 주식·무제한 급여해도 된다는 안전성 시험도 아니다.

records.source_title: The Tortoise Table. Harebell (Campanula rotundifolia).

records.source_title: The Tortoise Table. Broadleaf Filaree.

records.source_title: Kew Plants of the World Online. Dichondra micrantha Urb.

records.source_title: The Tortoise Table. Vetch (Common Vetch, Hairy Tare, Tufted Vetch).

records.source_title: Tortoise Food – Growing from Seed Guide.

records.source_title: Naturescape Wildflower Farm. NT Tortoise Food Mix.

records.source_title: Preclinical toxicity and safety evaluation of Althaea officinalis L. extract in common carp
records.plant_part_state: plant extract added to feed; not equivalent to fresh tortoise forage
records.supports: 150마리의 잉어를 4개 처리군으로 나눠 Althaea officinalis 추출물 0, 2.5, 5, 10 g/kg 사료를 60일 급여하고 혈액·간 효소 지표를 비교했다. 2.5와 5 g/kg에서는 뚜렷한 간 효소 부작용이 확인되지 않았지만 10 g/kg에서는 AST·ALT·ALP·LDH 증가 등 세포독성을 시사하는 변화가 나타났다. 따라서 ‘천연 식물이라 무제한 안전하다’는 가정은 피해야 한다는 용량 의존적 독성 맥락을 제공한다.
records.does_not_support: 잉어에게 식물 추출물을 사료에 첨가한 연구로 신선한 잎·꽃을 먹는 육지거북과 노출 형태와 동물종이 모두 다르다. 잉어의 g/kg 용량을 육지거북 급여량으로 환산할 수 없고, 육지거북 먹이로서의 영양적 적합성도 입증하지 않는다.

records.source_title: The form, distribution and seasonal accumulation of calcium in kiwifruit leaves
records.plant_part_state: mature vine leaf blades across the growing season
records.supports: 성숙한 A. deliciosa 덩굴의 잎을 생육기간 동안 반복 채취해 칼슘과 마그네슘의 형태를 분석한 연구다. 잎의 칼슘 중 calcium oxalate가 모든 채취 시점에서 우세한 분획이었고, 어린 잎에서는 총 칼슘의 최대 79%, 낙엽기에는 약 42%를 차지했다. 따라서 키위잎의 총 칼슘 수치가 높더라도 상당 부분이 옥살산칼슘 형태일 수 있어 ‘칼슘이 많으니 좋은 먹이’라고 단순 평가하면 안 된다는 중요한 제한성분 근거다.
records.does_not_support: 식물 잎의 무기질 형태를 분석한 연구로 육지거북의 실제 칼슘 흡수율이나 옥살레이트 독성을 측정하지 않았다. 이 비율을 육지거북의 결석 위험이나 안전 급여량으로 직접 환산할 수 없다.

records.source_title: Phytotoxic activity of kiwifruit leaves and isolation of a phytotoxic substance
records.supports: Hayward 키위의 잎 추출물을 여러 시험식물에 처리한 결과 농도 의존적인 생장 억제가 나타났고, 잎에서 (-)-epicatechin을 식물독성 활성에 기여하는 물질로 분리·동정했다. 이는 키위잎이 생물학적으로 불활성인 단순 잎이 아니라 여러 활성성분을 가진다는 제한성분 맥락을 제공한다.
records.does_not_support: 여기서 ‘phytotoxic’은 다른 식물의 발아·생장을 억제하는 타감작용을 뜻하며 동물 독성과 같은 개념이 아니다. 따라서 이 결과만으로 키위잎이 육지거북에게 독성이라고 결론내릴 수 없고, 경구 안전량도 정할 수 없다.

records.source_title: Nutritional and antinutritional composition of vegetable and grain amaranth leaves
records.supports: Amaranthus 10종 61개 계통의 잎을 비교해 단백질·카로티노이드·수분뿐 아니라 nitrate와 oxalate를 함께 분석한 연구다. 비름류 잎은 영양소가 풍부할 수 있지만 종·계통에 따라 항영양성분도 함께 존재하므로, ‘칼슘이 많은 잎채소’라는 이유만으로 육지거북 먹이 적합성을 판단하면 안 된다는 직접 식물성분 근거다.
records.does_not_support: Amaranthus 속 여러 종을 묶어 비교한 식물성분 연구이며 현재 DB의 ‘비름’이 어느 종인지 확정하지 않는다. 육지거북 급여시험도 아니므로 특정 종의 안전량·급여 빈도·장기 영향을 정할 수 없다.

records.source_title: Comparative Effects of Glycine max and Glycine soja Leaves on Clanis bilineata tsingtauica Rearing Performance
records.animal_taxon: Clanis bilineata tsingtauica larvae; leaf composition
records.supports: 재배콩(Glycine max) 잎 자체의 영양·항영양 성분을 분석하고 초식성 곤충의 먹이로 사용한 연구다. G. max 잎은 조단백질 약 242.5 g/kg, 조섬유 9.68%, Ca 3.41 g/kg, P 2.38 g/kg로 측정돼 Ca:P는 약 1.43:1이었다. 동시에 잎에서 trypsin inhibitor와 phytic acid도 정량돼 콩알뿐 아니라 잎에도 항영양성분이 존재함을 확인했다.
records.does_not_support: 초식성 곤충을 대상으로 한 연구이며 육지거북의 소화·안전성 시험이 아니다. 이 영양수치와 항영양성분을 육지거북의 적정 급여량으로 환산할 수 없고, 품종·생육단계가 다른 모든 콩잎에 동일한 수치를 적용할 수도 없다.

records.source_title: Induction of Trypsin Inhibitors in Soybean Leaves by Mexican Bean Beetle Defoliation
records.animal_taxon: Plant chemistry; Mexican bean beetle herbivory
records.supports: 8개 재배콩 계통의 잎에서 trypsin inhibitory activity를 직접 측정한 연구다. 개화 전 잎에서도 억제 활성이 검출됐고, 식물이 성숙하고 초식 피해가 증가하면서 모든 계통에서 활성이 4–23배 증가했다. 따라서 콩잎의 protease inhibitor 수준은 고정된 값이 아니며 생육단계와 초식 스트레스에 따라 크게 달라질 수 있다는 제한성분 근거다.
records.does_not_support: 곤충 초식에 대한 식물 방어반응 연구이며 육지거북에서 단백질 소화 저해나 임상 부작용을 측정한 것이 아니다. 특정 trypsin inhibitor 수치로 육지거북의 독성량이나 안전 급여량을 계산할 수 없다.

records.source_title: Oxalate Contents of Raw, Boiled, Wok-Fried and Pesto and Juice Made from Fat Hen (Chenopodium album) Leaves
records.supports: HPLC measurement found total oxalate of 1112.4 mg/100 g dry matter in raw Chenopodium album leaves; boiling and wok cooking reduced total oxalate. This directly supports the presence and magnitude of a limiting compound in the exact plant and leaf part.
records.does_not_support: This is a plant-composition study, not a tortoise feeding or toxicity trial. It does not establish a tortoise toxic dose, safe percentage, feeding frequency, or prove that a small accidental ingestion causes poisoning.

records.source_title: Oxalate content of silver beet leaves (Beta vulgaris var. cicla) at different stages of maturation and the effect of cooking with different milk sources
records.supports: Measured high soluble oxalate in Beta vulgaris var. cicla leaves, with regrowth tissue reaching 7267 ± 307 mg/100 g dry matter and soluble oxalate comprising 58–89% of total oxalate depending on maturity. This supports treating oxalate as a real leaf-specific limiting factor.
records.does_not_support: The studied taxon is silver beet/chard within Beta vulgaris, not a controlled tortoise feeding study of every beet cultivar. It does not define a tortoise toxic dose, exact safe serving size, or feeding frequency.

records.source_title: Identification of the major glucosinolate (4-mercaptobutyl glucosinolate) in leaves of Eruca sativa L. (salad rocket)
records.supports: LC/MS, LC/MS/MS and NMR identified 4-mercaptobutyl glucosinolate as the major glucosinolate in Eruca sativa leaves, with additional glucosinolates also present. This confirms that the limiting-compound discussion for rocket leaves has a direct plant-chemistry basis.
records.does_not_support: This study identifies leaf glucosinolates; it does not test thyroid function, toxicity, palatability, or safe intake in tortoises and therefore cannot by itself define a feeding percentage or frequency.

records.source_title: The natural abundance of L-canavanine, an active anticancer agent, in alfalfa, Medicago sativa (L.)
records.plant_part_state: commercially grown sprouts; seeds also analysed
records.supports: Commercially grown alfalfa sprouts contained appreciable L-canavanine, ranging from 1.3 to 2.4% of dry matter depending on source. The study identifies a non-protein amino acid/arginine antimetabolite in the exact sprout food concept.
records.does_not_support: This is not a tortoise feeding or toxicity trial. The measured canavanine concentration does not establish a tortoise toxic dose, safe serving size, feeding frequency, or prove that a small accidental ingestion causes clinical toxicity.

records.source_title: Production and biological activity of saponins and canavanine in alfalfa seedlings
records.plant_part_state: growing seedlings; roots and shoots across early development
records.supports: In growing alfalfa seedlings, canavanine reached 3.2% of dry mass on day 6 and then declined; saponins followed a different time course, reaching 1.8% in shoots on day 8 before declining. This demonstrates that limiting compounds are present in the exact seedling stage and vary substantially with age.
records.does_not_support: The biological assays were not tortoise feeding trials. These concentrations cannot be converted into a tortoise toxic dose, exact safe percentage, or fixed feeding interval, and seedling age materially changes composition.

records.source_title: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids in borage (Borago officinalis): Comprehensive profiling and development of a validated LC-MS/MS method for quantification
records.supports: UHPLC-QToF profiling and a validated LC-MS/MS method identified and quantified multiple pyrrolizidine alkaloids and their N-oxides in Borago officinalis leaf material. This confirms that borage leaves themselves contain a class of compounds relevant to safety assessment.
records.does_not_support: This is plant-chemistry and food-safety evidence, not a tortoise feeding or toxicity trial. It does not establish a tortoise toxic dose, a one-bite poisoning threshold, or the clinical outcome of accidental ingestion.

records.source_title: Evaluation of Major Minerals and Trace Elements in Wild and Domesticated Edible Herbs Traditionally Used in the Mediterranean Area
records.supports: The study measured nitrate and oxalate in Rumex acetosa leaves under wild and several cultivation conditions. Open-field leaves reached 8.50 ± 0.21 mg oxalate/g fresh weight, confirming that oxalate can be a substantial leaf-specific limiting factor and varies with cultivation.
records.does_not_support: The study concerns plant composition and human-food interpretation, not tortoise feeding. It does not establish a tortoise toxic dose, exact safe portion, fixed feeding frequency, or prove that a small accidental ingestion causes poisoning.

records.source_title: Identification and Accumulation of Phenolic Compounds in the Leaves and Bark of Salix alba (L.) and Their Biological Potential
records.supports: UPLC-PDA-Q/TOF-MS identified 29 phenolic compounds in Salix alba leaves and demonstrated a substantial leaf phenolic profile. The paper provides exact-species, leaf-specific chemistry relevant to interpreting why willow foliage should not be treated as nutritionally neutral.
records.does_not_support: This is not a tortoise feeding or toxicity trial and Salix alba is only one species within Salix. It does not demonstrate that all willow species have identical chemistry, establish a tortoise toxic dose, or by itself prove that willow leaves must be excluded.

records.source_title: Evaluation of Major Minerals and Trace Elements in Wild and Domesticated Edible Herbs Traditionally Used in the Mediterranean Area
records.supports: The study measured nitrate and oxalate directly in Rumex acetosa leaves under wild and several cultivation conditions and found substantial oxalate, with the highest R. acetosa value reported in open-field cultivated leaves. This confirms a leaf-specific limiting compound in the exact species.
records.does_not_support: The study evaluates edible-plant composition, not tortoise feeding. It does not define a tortoise toxic dose, safe serving size, frequency, or demonstrate clinical poisoning after incidental ingestion.

records.source_title: Identification and Accumulation of Phenolic Compounds in the Leaves and Bark of Salix alba (L.) and Their Biological Potential
records.plant_part_state: leaves and bark; leaf results separable
records.supports: UPLC-PDA-Q/TOF-MS identified numerous phenolic compounds in Salix alba leaves and quantified a high total phenolic content. This provides exact-species leaf chemistry showing that willow foliage contains biologically active phenolic constituents.
records.does_not_support: This is Salix alba chemistry, not a tortoise feeding/toxicity trial and not proof that every Salix species has the same profile or hazard. It does not establish a tortoise toxic dose, safe frequency, or show that a small accidental bite is poisonous.

records.source_title: Evaluation of Major Minerals and Trace Elements in Wild and Domesticated Edible Herbs Traditionally Used in the Mediterranean Area
records.supports: The study measured nitrate and oxalate in Rumex acetosa leaves under wild and cultivation conditions. Open-field R. acetosa leaves reached 8.5 mg oxalate/g fresh weight, confirming substantial oxalate in the exact species and leaf part.
records.does_not_support: This is plant composition, not a tortoise feeding study. The measured oxalate level cannot be converted into a tortoise toxic dose, fixed safe serving, or proof that accidental small ingestion causes poisoning.

records.source_title: The presence or absence of phenolglycosides in Salix (Salicaceae) leaves and the level of dietary specialisation of some of their herbivorous insects
records.supports: Comparative work on European Salix species showed that willow leaves differ substantially in secondary chemistry, including phenolic glycosides. This supports treating Salix leaf chemistry as species-dependent rather than assuming all willow leaves are compositionally equivalent.
records.does_not_support: This study concerns willow chemistry and herbivorous insects, not tortoises. It does not establish that phenolic glycosides make willow leaves toxic to tortoises, nor does it define a tortoise toxic dose or justify a genus-wide poisoning claim.

records.source_title: Pyrrolizidine alkaloid contents and profiles in Borago officinalis leaves, flowers and microgreens: Implications for safety
records.plant_part_state: 106 leaf samples including microgreens and 33 flower samples across developmental stages
records.supports: LC-MS/MS analysis quantified pyrrolizidine alkaloids in Borago officinalis leaves, flowers and microgreens. All analyzed flowers contained PA; flowers generally contained more than corresponding leaves, while microgreens and pre-flowering leaves showed particularly high concentrations. This confirms toxicologically relevant PA in the exact plant and the same aerial parts considered for feeding.
records.does_not_support: This is a food-safety and plant-chemistry study, not a tortoise feeding or toxicity trial. Human regulatory limits and margin-of-exposure calculations cannot be converted into a tortoise toxic dose, safe serving size, or prediction that a single accidental bite will cause poisoning.

records.source_title: Pyrrolizidine alkaloid contents and profiles in Borago officinalis leaves, flowers and microgreens: Implications for safety
records.plant_part_state: 106 leaf samples including microgreens and multiple developmental stages; 33 flower samples
records.supports: A 2025 Food Control study directly quantified pyrrolizidine alkaloids in 106 borage leaf samples and 33 flower samples. Microgreens had the highest PA contents, pre-flowering leaves often exceeded the EU food maximum, and all analyzed flowers contained PA; flowers generally contained more PA than corresponding leaves.
records.does_not_support: This is plant toxicology/food-safety evidence, not a tortoise feeding trial. Human food regulatory limits cannot be converted into a tortoise toxic dose, one-bite poisoning claim, exact safe percentage, or species-specific clinical threshold.

records.source_title: Evaluation of Major Minerals and Trace Elements in Wild and Domesticated Edible Herbs Traditionally Used in the Mediterranean Area
records.plant_part_state: leaves; wild and multiple cultivation systems
records.supports: Rumex acetosa leaves were directly analyzed for oxalate under wild and cultivated conditions. The study reported high leaf oxalate, with open-field cultivated leaves reaching about 8.5 mg oxalate/g fresh weight, confirming a substantial leaf-specific calcium-binding antinutrient burden.
